DeskHub Cable Organizer

$24.00

DeskHub routes chargers, monitor cables, and USB cords under a desk or along a wall. It helps remote workers, gamers, and small offices keep workspaces tidy without drilling permanent holes.

The kit includes six adhesive channels, reusable labels, alcohol cleaning pads, and a setup guide. It fits common USB-C, HDMI, power, and ethernet cables.

  • Six 14-inch channels
  • Removable adhesive backing
  • Matte black and white color options
  • 30-day returns, free shipping over $50, and responsive support

FAQ

Will it damage my desk?

The adhesive is removable on most sealed surfaces when removed carefully.

How many cables fit?

Most channels fit three to five common charging or monitor cables.
